result.reason: The clause otherwise closely tracks the preferred position: it is mutual, uses the greater of paid-or-payable 12-month fees and USD 1,000,000, excludes indirect/consequential damages, includes the requested substantive carve-outs, and excludes Client payment obligations from the cap. However, the indemnification carve-out is limited to obligations “under this Section 12,” with no basis in the supplied text that indemnification obligations are located there; if they are elsewhere, the required indemnification carve-out is ineffective, so even the fallback is not clearly met. It also unnecessarily adds incidental damages and measures the fee period from the event giving rise to the claim rather than from the claim, as specified by the preferred position.
